support_claim: MSA-MER-2024 names Meridian Energy Partners LLC as counterparty, billing records that same legal name as the billed party, and commercial notes state Meridian Energy Partners invoices are the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024.

critic.reason: The contract header names Meridian Energy Partners LLC as counterparty, billing records use that same legal name, and commercial notes explicitly tie those invoices to the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024, establishing—not merely suggesting—the same legal counterparty.
